Official Aleo developer docs with full address table (section 2.3): Ethereum mainnet xReserve=0x8888888199b2Df864bf678259607d6D5EBb4e3Ce, Ethereum mainnet USDC=0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48, Sepolia xReserve=0x008888878f94C0d87defdf0B07f46B93C1934442, Sepolia USDC=0x1c7D4B196Cb0C7B01d743Fbc6116a902379C7238. Also documents Aleo program IDs: usdcx_stablecoin.aleo, usdcx_bridge_v2.aleo, shielded_usdcx_wrapper.aleo, and admin multisig reference usdcx_multisig_core.aleo. Shielded wrapper Aleo address: aleo183r3zgsr57fwtgk5duzeq9kqdkpmmtfj4k5469ddvm3tcfhhls9szktw82.
Confirms USDCx is deployed on Aleo using Circle xReserve; for every USDCx minted on Aleo, an equivalent amount of USDC is locked in a smart contract on Ethereum.

Confirms usdcx_stablecoin.aleo is the first private stablecoin on Aleo developed by Aleo in partnership with Circle; references usdcx_multisig_core.aleo as admin operations protector requiring multiple signers.

protocol_metadata.about: USDCx is a private, USDC-backed stablecoin deployed on the Aleo network by Aleo Network Foundation in partnership with Circle. Users deposit USDC into Circle's xReserve smart contract on Ethereum, which locks the funds and triggers minting of an equivalent amount of USDCx on Aleo via Circle's attestation service. USDCx leverages Aleo's zero-knowledge proof architecture to keep transaction details (sender, receiver, amount) encrypted by default, while supporting selective disclosure for compliance and audit purposes. The protocol uses a burn-and-mint mechanism via Circle's CCTP and Gateway infrastructure for redemption back to USDC on supported chains, without relying on third-party bridges.
